canonical_project: GCRE Energy and Data Centre Partner opportunity (Onllwyn)
owner: Global Centre of Rail Excellence Ltd; investment partner to be selected

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: GCRE (Nant Helen opencast site, Onllwyn, Neath Port Talbot) is running an Energy and Data Centre Partner competition for its ~700 ha site, with a mandatory proposal to acquire up to ~80 ha on a 999-year lease for data centre assets; multi-billion-pound investment possible; partner expected by end-2026; capacity not disclosed.
